model: Composite insurer FCFE at cost of equity, net debt held at zero (engine route)

equity_bridge.item: HK$15.556bn zero-coupon H-share convertible bonds due 2030, at principal in CNY
equity_bridge.note: HK$15,556m / 1.1724 = RMB13,268m. Conversion price HK$37.51 is 42% above the market price and above all three scenario values, so the bond is modelled as redeemed from shareholder resources in 2030 rather than converted; the carrying amount is 12,075 liability + 1,064 derivative = 13,139 at 30 June 2026 (H1 2026 notes 12 and derivative financial liabilities). Deducted once here because the FCFE stream (dividends) does not provide for its repayment, while the accretion (part of FY2025 interest expense 4,164 vs 2,728) is already inside PBT. If instead converted: +414.7m shares, no deduction -- base value per share ~0.7% lower.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: long-run growth of the earning base -- Group EV +5.7% 3yr CAGR (519.6bn FY2022 -> 613.4bn FY2025, 636.9bn at H1 2026), OPAT +6.1% FY2025 / +6.2% H1 2026, value of in-force +13.0%, insurance revenue +3.4% FY2025 / +1.0% H1 2026; fades to 3% terminal. Revenue CAGRs span the IFRS 17 break (FY2022 332bn vs FY2021 436bn is the standard change, not a 24% fall), EPS CAGRs start from pre-IFRS 17 years and end on a 6.1%-yield peak, and equity CAGRs are depressed by the FY2022 restatement trough; none is used directly.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR 15.4% diverges from revenue 3yr CAGR 9.4% by more than 30% (relative): FY2022 equity 196,477 is the IFRS 17 restatement trough (FY2021 226,741 on IFRS 4) and FY2025 302,143 benefits from the FY2024-25 equity-market rally in OCI, so the equity CAGR is an accounting artefact; the revenue CAGR is also inflated by investment income normalising upward from the FY2022 trough. Both flagged and set aside in favour of the EV / OPAT-based judgment above.

scenario_narratives.base: Dividend-driven FCFE on a normalised earnings base: FY2026 NI ~51bn, FY2027 ~43.5bn (~1.07x OPAT), then 5% fading to 3% growth; payout of NI 24% -> 50% as the new interim dividend and the OPAT-anchored policy mature; CoE 10.5% CNY. Value is roughly 0.37x embedded value and ~0.75x H1 2026 book -- the market is paying for the dividends it receives, not the EV.
scenario_narratives.bull: Investment yields hold near 5%, NBV compounds at double digits, the combined ratio stays at 95% and the group releases surplus capital: payout to 60%, CoE 10%.
scenario_narratives.bear: Low-rate spread compression plus a China equity drawdown pull NI to the OPAT-only level and keep it there; solvency drift caps the payout at 40%; CoE 11.5%; the convertible is redeemed in cash in 2030.

valuation_philosophy.summary: CPIC is valued on the cash that leaves the solvency perimeter for shareholders -- dividends -- discounted at a CNY cost of equity, with net debt at zero and the 2030 convertible deducted as a holdco claim. The embedded value (HKD ~78/share) and the book value (HKD ~39/share) are cross-checks on how much surplus the group holds that the FCFE does not release; the gap between them and the FCFE value is the price of Chinese-insurer capital retention, not a mispricing the model can bank on. The payout path is the dominant lever: each 10 points of terminal payout is worth roughly 15% of the base value.
key_risks_to_valuation: Payout path: the base case needs the payout of NI to double (24% -> 50%) over ten years; the policy is anchored to OPAT and solvency and management has given no numeric commitment
Investment yield: FY2025 NI carries ~RMB17bn of investment result above OPAT; a sustained comprehensive yield below the ~4.5% assumed in the normalisation removes the FY2027 margin cushion
Spread compression: net investment yield 3.4% (-0.4pt) against long-duration guaranteed and participating liabilities as China risk-free rates fall; preset rate cut to 1.99% in Aug 2025
Solvency drift: core 191% / comprehensive 255% at H1 2026, down 15/18pt in six months; a further fall constrains the payout path directly
Convertible overhang: HK$15.556bn due 2030 -- redemption in cash (modelled) or 4.1% dilution if the H-share recovers above HK$37.51
A/H discount and FX: the H-share trades 23% below the A-share; the model is in CNY and bridged at 1.1724, so HKD/CNY moves flow straight into the quote-currency value
Regulation: NFRA commission ('integration of reporting and conduct') rules, illustrated-rate caps and C-ROSS II capital requirements are deliberate margin-compression tools

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API for 2601.HK at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 26.08-40.46 HKD. CNYHKD=X and 601601.SS from the same endpoint for the FX bridge and A/H parity check.
data_sources.financials: 2601.HK_Metrics.csv (core_metrics export, RMB millions, FY2017-FY2025 + half-years); FY2025 Annual Report (consolidated income statement, note 23 bonds payable, profit distribution and dividend history, EV section, convertible bond section) and H1 2026 Interim Report (key indicators, note 12 bonds payable, convertible bond section, non-recurring items) in Extracted/.
data_sources.qualitative: 2601.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-18); sibling insurer builds 1336.HK and 2378.HK for model consistency.

inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2025 Group operating income (consolidated income statement total: insurance revenue 288,910 + investment income and other). The engine's 'revenue' is this total; the PBT margin path is built on it. Insurance revenue alone (288,910) is the stabler series but excludes the investment result that drives half of the earnings swing, so the margin path is where the normalisation lives.
inputs.share_count_basis: 9,620,341,455 shares in issue at 30 June 2026 (H1 2026 interim report, Bonds Convertible into H Shares table: 6,845,041,455 A shares 71.15% + 2,775,300,000 H shares 28.85%), unchanged since the 2020 GDR issue (9,062m -> 9,620m). No share-based payment scheme, no treasury shares; FY2025 weighted average 9,620m. A and H shares rank pari passu for dividends, so the per-share value is on the total count and the H-share price is compared against it. Held FLAT. The HK$15.556bn zero-coupon convertible due 2030 would add 414,716,075 H shares (+4.13%) at the adjusted HK$37.51 conversion price; that price is 42% above the market and above every scenario's intrinsic value, so the bond is treated as a claim to be redeemed (deducted in equity_bridge), not as dilution. If-converted alternative: 10,035.06m shares and no deduction -- about 0.7% lower per-share value in the base case, i.e. the treatment is not sensitive.
inputs.net_debt_note: Held at zero on the insurer convention: the RMB10,103m CPIC P/C capital replenishment bonds are regulatory solvency capital whose coupons are already inside PBT, and the RMB2.9tn of insurance contract liabilities are operating funding, not debt. The convertible bond is the one holdco financing claim outside that convention and is carried in equity_bridge.
inputs.total_debt_note: Bonds payable at 30 June 2026 (H1 2026 interim note 12): 10,103 CPIC P/C 10-year capital replenishment bonds (RMB7.0bn 3.72% + RMB3.0bn 3.55%, 2023 issues) + 12,075 liability component of the HK$15.556bn convertible. Excludes repo/securities-sold-under-agreements (investment funding) and insurance liabilities.
inputs.last_fcf_note: FCFE for FY2025 = cash dividend declared for FY2025: RMB1.15 x 9,620.34m = RMB11,063m (FY2025 AR profit distribution, 20.7% of attributable NI 53,505, 30.3% of OPAT 36,523). This is the flow the model discounts: the dividend is the only cash that leaves the solvency perimeter for shareholders.
inputs.reported_fcf_note: CSV OCF 195,523 less capex 4,284 for FY2025. Policyholder float, not owner cash -- retained for audit only and NOT the base of the model.
inputs.sbc_source: none -- CPIC operates no share-based payment scheme (FY2025 AR share capital and remuneration disclosures; basic EPS 5.56 vs diluted 5.54, the gap being the convertible bond only). SBC-zero market: house and street bases coincide.
inputs.fx_note: CNYHKD=X 1.1724 HKD per CNY, Yahoo Finance regular close 2026-10-16T22:01Z; model values are CNY and are multiplied by this rate into the HKD quote currency. Parity check: A-share 601601.SS closed RMB29.32 on 2026-10-16 = HKD34.37 at this rate, against the H-share close -- a 23% H-share discount to the A-share, the usual structural A/H gap for Chinese financials (1336.HK shows 31%), not a data error. fx_rate is REQUIRED for sanity_check.py / refresh_price.py; refresh_price.py does not update it (known gap), so re-fetch on the next refresh.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-16T08:08:14Z (HKEX regular close, Friday; valuation written Saturday 2026-10-18 -- not an after-hours print)
inputs.wacc_rationale: Cost of EQUITY 10.5%, built in CNY because the flows are CNY: China 10-year government bond ~1.8% + beta ~1.3 x 6.5% China equity risk premium = ~10.3%, rounded to 10.5%. Same rate as 1336.HK (New China Life) and 0998.HK (China CITIC Bank) in this folder; CPIC's earnings are less capital-markets-levered than NCI's (equity-category assets 17.1% of the portfolio; comprehensive investment yield 2.3% / 2.7% / 6.0% / 6.1% FY2022-25) but the group carries a 2030 holdco convertible and a China-only franchise, so no discount to the peer rate. Not a WACC: the flow is post-interest, post-tax FCFE to shareholders and net debt is held at zero, so the rate is the shareholders' required return. Bull 10.0% / bear 11.5% move the rate by the same +-50/100bp as the sibling insurers.
inputs.lease_treatment: Lease liabilities RMB1,571m (FY2025) are immaterial (0.05% of total assets); lease costs stay inside PBT, no separate lease charge, no debt treatment.
inputs.nci_treatment: Non-controlling interests (RMB31,650m at 30 June 2026, mostly perpetual bonds classified as equity and minority stakes in CPIC P/C / asset-management subsidiaries) are charged through the tax path: cash_tax_rate 19% = income tax 16.1% + NCI share of net profit 2.9% of PBT in FY2025 (10,669 + 1,894 over 66,068; FY2024 19.1%). H1 2026 ran at 11.2% on a low tax charge (2,999 on 34,653 PBT) -- the 19% path is deliberately conservative against that.
inputs.notes: MODEL: FCFE at cost of equity on a Chinese composite insurer (life + P&C + asset management), run through the component engine with net debt at zero -- the 1336.HK / 2378.HK / LGEN.L / PRU pattern in this folder (SKILL.md routing row: insurer). Not the owner-FCF DCF: OCF of RMB138-196bn a year is policyholder float and EBITDA does not exist. Not the routing table's default BVPS x exit-P/B: IFRS 17 shareholders' equity (RMB319.2bn, RMB33.18/share at H1 2026) excludes the RMB364bn contractual service margin store of future life profit and swings with OCI, and the FY2022 IFRS 17 restatement breaks the BVPS series (226.7bn -> 196.5bn with no economic loss). Embedded value (RMB636.9bn, RMB66.21/share = HKD77.6 at H1 2026) is the CROSS-CHECK, not the engine: the H-share trades at 0.34x EV and the base IV is ~0.37x EV, which says what the FCFE model says -- the market capitalises CPIC's dividends, not its EV, because the surplus is not being released. ENGINE MAPPING: revenue = Group operating income; ebitda_margin_path = profit before tax / revenue (FY2025 15.2%, FY2024 13.8%, FY2023 9.9%); sbc 0; da 0; cash_tax_rate 19% = tax + NCI; capex_pct = margin x 0.81 x (1 - payout) is the retention plug, so FCF = attributable net income x payout ratio = dividend; wc 0. NORMALISATION: FY2025 attributable NI RMB53.5bn sits on a 6.1% comprehensive investment yield (RMB17bn above OPAT RMB36.5bn, which strips short-term investment variance); H1 2026 NI 30.8bn included ~1.26bn of convertible-bond revaluation gain and ran at an 8.7% tax rate while the comprehensive yield fell to 1.8% (non-annualised). FY2026 is set near H1 x 2 less a weaker H2; FY2027 steps the margin down to 12.0% (NI ~43.5bn, ~1.07x a 5%-growing OPAT) and the earning base then grows with investment assets / CSM / insurance revenue at 5% fading to 3%. CONVERTIBLE: HK$15.556bn zero-coupon due Sept 2030, conversion price HK$37.51 (adjusted 22 June 2026), issued when the H-share was HK$30.90; carried in equity_bridge at the RMB principal (-13,268) because redemption is the likelier path at a 42% out-of-the-money strike, and the dividend stream does not fund it. PAYOUT is the dominant lever: policy anchors dividends to OPAT (~30% of OPAT, 20.7% of NI in FY2025), the first-ever interim dividend (RMB0.42, Aug 2026) and the 'stable, sustainable, predictable' language support a rising path; base reaches 50% of NI by FY2035, bull 60%, bear 40%. Core solvency 191% / comprehensive 255% at H1 2026 (down 15/18pt in six months) is the constraint on going faster.

bear.narrative: FY2026 H2 equity-market and bond-yield drawdown takes the full-year NI to ~45bn (-16%); FY2027 revenue -5% with investment income collapsing to the OPAT-only level and the margin at 9.5% (NI ~32bn, i.e. no investment contribution and OPAT flat as the 3.4% net investment yield compresses against guaranteed liabilities; NFRA bancassurance commission rules slow life growth; NEV motor keeps the combined ratio near 98%). Earning base grows only 3% fading to 2%. Core solvency keeps sliding toward ~160% after the C-ROSS II transition, so the payout stays anchored at ~30% of OPAT and reaches only 40% of NI; the 2030 convertible is redeemed in cash. Cost of equity 11.5%, terminal growth 2.5%, cap 11x.

base.payout_ratio_path_note: capex_pct = margin x (1 - 19% tax+NCI) x (1 - payout); payout of attributable NI 24%, 30%, 32%, 34%, 36%, 38%, 40%, 43%, 46%, 50%. FY2026 24% = DPS ~1.28 (0.42 interim + ~0.86 final, +11% on FY2025's 1.15 as the policy anchors to OPAT +6% plus the new interim) on NI ~51bn; FY2027 30% = dividend ~13bn growing with OPAT while NI normalises down.
base.narrative: FY2026: operating income +4% (H1 +5.8%; H2 investment income softer against a strong H2 2025 -- comprehensive yield 1.8% non-annualised in H1 2026, the H-share 35% off its 52-week high) at a 14.0% PBT margin = PBT ~63bn, attributable NI ~51bn (H1 30.8bn + H2 ~20.5bn vs 25.6bn in H2 2025). FY2027: revenue -1% and margin 12.0% as investment income normalises to a ~4.5% comprehensive yield -- NI ~43.5bn, about 1.07x an OPAT growing 5% (36.5bn FY2025 -> ~40.6bn FY2027). FY2028-35: earning base grows 5% fading to 3% (EV +5.7% CAGR, OPAT +6%, insurance revenue +3%), margin held at 12% (P&C combined ratio ~96%, NBV margin gains offset by spread compression as the net investment yield of 3.4% falls toward the cost of liabilities). Payout rises 24% -> 50% of NI. Cost of equity 10.5% CNY, 3% terminal growth, terminal multiple capped at 13x FCFE.

bull.narrative: FY2026 operating income +6% with H2 investment markets holding, NI ~55.8bn (+4%); FY2027 margin normalises only to 13% (comprehensive yield ~5%, NBV +12-13% a year lifting the CSM release, combined ratio sustained at 95%). Earning base grows 6% fading to 3.5% as health, pension and technology lines compound and the HK platform scales. Dividend policy follows through: payout of NI rises to 60% by FY2035 as the group releases surplus above a ~180% core solvency floor. Cost of equity 10.0%, terminal growth 3.5%, cap 15x.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 13x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 25% rather than the house 15%: the earnings base is capital-markets-levered (comprehensive yield 2.3% -> 6.1% -> 1.8% non-annualised across FY2022/FY2025/H1 2026), core solvency fell 15pt in six months after the C-ROSS II transition relief expired, the NFRA bancassurance commission rules bit from July 2026, and the H-share has fallen 35% from its 52-week high into a soft H2. Not 1336.HK's 30% because CPIC's earnings are more diversified (P&C ~RMB10bn NI at a 95-97% combined ratio, surrender rate 1.4%, equity-category assets 17% of the portfolio) and it has the longer, more consistent dividend record. Bull 25% rather than 35%: the upside case depends on a payout step-up that management has only begun to signal (first interim dividend) and on investment yields that the regulator's own preset-rate cuts say are falling.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
